name: 4D Neural Voxel Splatting
definition: A dynamic scene rendering method that combines voxel-based representations with neural Gaussian splatting. It decouples spatial structure from temporal dynamics by generating neural Gaussians on-demand from persistent voxel anchors and applying unified deformations via a HexPlane encoder, reducing memory complexity to O(fV + F) compared to O(N·T).
summary: 4D Neural Voxel Splatting renders dynamic scenes by generating time-varying Gaussians from persistent voxel anchors, achieving real-time performance with significantly lower memory consumption than static methods.
